description: Schema and semantic vectors for the calendar-event Strand profile: single canonical schema activation, half-open all-day and timed intervals on signed local anchors, the RFC 8984 recurrence subset with its implicit defaults and rejected members, TZDB identity, schedule revision checkpoint and basis binding, deterministic RSVP reducer projection, series/instance effective projection, RSVP admission, attendee roster invariants, and the RSVP response privacy branches. Server-side schedule notification derivation is carried by calendar-notification-fixture.json so the client and server profiles do not inherit each other vector closure.

schema_validation_cases.name: schedule_shape_timed_with_utc_timestamp_rejected
schema_validation_cases.first_expected_error: contains:is not valid under any of the given schemas

schema_validation_cases.name: schedule_shape_timed_with_utc_offset_rejected
schema_validation_cases.first_expected_error: contains:is not valid under any of the given schemas

schema_validation_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_over_cap_rejected
schema_validation_cases.instance_note: The wire array is retained for compatibility of the payload shape but maxItems=1 enforces the deterministic schedule winner; any extra basis ref is schema-invalid.

semantic_cases.name: activation_removing_schema_ref_but_keeping_subtree_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: Strand carries ak.schema.calendar_event.v1 and metadata.fields.calendar
semantic_cases.action: ak.strand.update removes only the schema ref

semantic_cases.name: activation_write_without_requirements_schema_binding_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: target Strand activates the calendar schema
semantic_cases.action: ak.strand.update writes metadata.fields.calendar without listing ak.schema.calendar_event.v1 in requirements.schema[]

semantic_cases.name: schedule_shape_end_not_after_start_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: all_day=true single-day event authored as end equal to start

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_expansion_base_start_is_first_occurrence
semantic_cases.precondition: weekly recurrence whose by_day does not contain the base weekday
semantic_cases.expected_projection: base start is emitted first and consumes one count unit; the remaining occurrences follow by_day

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_expansion_scan_budget_returns_continuation
semantic_cases.precondition: rule that matches no candidate period inside the requested range
semantic_cases.action: expand with the registered candidate-period scan budget
semantic_cases.expected_projection: limit_exceeded with a continuation bound to schedule revision, tzdb_version, range and sort key

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_expansion_continuation_invalid_after_schedule_change
semantic_cases.precondition: a continuation issued against schedule revision R1
semantic_cases.action: resume expansion after an accepted schedule revision R2

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_dst_gap_uses_pre_transition_offset
semantic_cases.precondition: daily 02:30 local event in America/Los_Angeles crossing the spring-forward gap
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the nonexistent local time resolves with the offset in effect before the transition; the local wall-clock key stays 02:30 and does not drift

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_dst_fold_uses_pre_transition_offset
semantic_cases.precondition: daily 01:30 local event in America/Los_Angeles crossing the fall-back overlap
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the ambiguous local time resolves with the offset in effect before the transition, and exactly one occurrence is emitted

semantic_cases.name: tzdb_identity_alias_must_be_canonicalized_before_signing
semantic_cases.precondition: producer input timezone is the UTC alias
semantic_cases.action: ak.strand.create carrying timezone=UTC on the wire

semantic_cases.name: tzdb_identity_unknown_release_fails_closed
semantic_cases.precondition: schedule pins a tzdb_version outside ServiceDescribe.calendar_tzdb_versions

semantic_cases.name: tzdb_identity_version_bump_preserves_local_keys
semantic_cases.precondition: schedule updated from one release to a later release
semantic_cases.expected_projection: local occurrence keys and the signed timezone are unchanged; only derived instants may move, and any moved instant marks affected RSVPs needs_reconfirmation

semantic_cases.name: recurrence_unsupported_rdate_exdate_fail_closed
semantic_cases.precondition: client attempts per-instance reschedule or cancellation

semantic_cases.name: schedule_revision_identity_edit_orphans_instance_rsvp
semantic_cases.precondition: instance RSVP exists for a timed occurrence
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the old instance RSVP is retained for audit and marked stale_orphaned; it is never migrated to the new key, while series RSVPs are marked needs_reconfirmation

semantic_cases.name: schedule_revision_concurrent_writes_choose_one_winner
semantic_cases.precondition: two concurrent accepted schedule updates produce different canonical calendar bytes
semantic_cases.action: compute the schedule current-value projection and author ak.rsvp.set against its winner
semantic_cases.expected_projection: exactly one schedule_revision_source wins by fixed (depth,EventId) rank; schedule_basis_refs contains only that source and no resolution Event is required

semantic_cases.name: schedule_revision_unreadable_winner_blocks_local_authoring
semantic_cases.precondition: the deterministic schedule winner is encrypted and the authoring client lacks a valid scope key
semantic_cases.action: authoring client attempts to construct ak.rsvp.set
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the refusal happens client-side because winner readability needs schedule plaintext; a server MUST NOT use it as an admission gate

semantic_cases.name: schedule_revision_equal_value_writes_still_choose_one_identity
semantic_cases.precondition: two concurrent writes decrypt to identical canonical calendar bytes
semantic_cases.expected_projection: one source identity wins by fixed (depth,EventId) rank; equal plaintext does not merge Event identities

semantic_cases.name: schedule_revision_non_calendar_update_is_not_a_revision
semantic_cases.precondition: an ak.strand.update that only changes metadata.title
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the winner is unchanged and previously authored RSVP basis values stay current

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_reducer_projection_value_must_equal_payload_entry
semantic_cases.precondition: registry declares result_projection set(payload.entry), and the submitted Event contains only kind plus its typed payload rather than producer-selected writes
semantic_cases.action: mutate the reducer implementation so the projected set value differs from payload.entry

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_reducer_projection_missing_write_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: registry declares exactly one typed current result write for ak.rsvp.set
semantic_cases.action: mutate the reducer implementation so it omits the registered RSVP typed current result write

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_reducer_projection_extra_target_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: registry declares exactly one RSVP typed current result target for ak.rsvp.set
semantic_cases.action: mutate the reducer implementation so it also projects an unregistered typed current result write

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_effective_projection_instance_overrides_series
semantic_cases.precondition: same responder has a series-typed current result winner and an instance-typed current result winner for the same occurrence
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the instance winner is used; the series winner is only a fallback and the two typed results are never unioned

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_effective_projection_causal_successor_dominates
semantic_cases.precondition: the same responder rewrites an earlier RSVP while observing it
semantic_cases.action: join the current-value projection typed current result in either arrival order
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the causal successor is the unique winner and the result is independent of arrival order, HLC and created_at

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_effective_projection_missing_key_is_not_a_status
semantic_cases.precondition: reader lacks the scope key for an encrypted response winner
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the winner is marked encrypted_unresolved; no status is fabricated and the winner is excluded from the effective response

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_effective_projection_ciphertext_difference_is_not_conflict
semantic_cases.precondition: two concurrent writes whose plaintext responses and basis are identical
semantic_cases.action: compute the current-value projection winner after decryption
semantic_cases.expected_projection: one source identity wins by fixed (depth,EventId) rank; equal plaintext does not merge identities or create conflict

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_non_attendee_with_capability_accepted
semantic_cases.precondition: actor is absent from attendees but holds ak.rsvp.set over the exact Strand
semantic_cases.expected_projection: attendees is schedule data, not an authorization source; the capability grant decides

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_attendee_without_capability_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: actor appears in attendees but holds no capability covering the Strand

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_cancelled_event_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: calendar.status is cancelled; the authoring client can decrypt the schedule
semantic_cases.action: authoring client attempts to construct a new ak.rsvp.set
semantic_cases.expected_projection: refusal is client-side because status needs schedule plaintext; historical RSVP projection is retained and a late winner is shown as a response to a cancelled event

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_not_typed_event_id_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: entry.schedule_basis_refs holds one item that is not a well-formed ak:event: typed id (shape admission, decidable without resolving anything)

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_pending_dependency
semantic_cases.precondition: basis passes shape admission but one referenced Event has not arrived
semantic_cases.expected_projection: target admission only reads the referenced Events plaintext envelope; the RSVP stays pending until they arrive and is never accepted as if the basis resolved

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_missing_target_is_not_an_oracle
semantic_cases.precondition: event_ref is absent, invisible, cross-Realm, or not a calendar Strand
semantic_cases.expected_projection: all four inputs produce the same externally visible error under the existing anti-enumeration policy; internal reason codes may differ

semantic_cases.name: attendee_roster_duplicate_actor_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: roster lists the same actor_id twice with different roles

semantic_cases.name: attendee_roster_does_not_widen_access
semantic_cases.precondition: an actor without Realm or Circle read access is added to attendees
semantic_cases.expected_projection: no membership is created, history access is unchanged, and the actor receives no notification or push wakeup

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_plaintext_branch_rejected_under_e2ee_floor
semantic_cases.precondition: target Strand scope has an accepted ak.mls.genesis
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying entry.response in plaintext

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_no_silent_plaintext_downgrade
semantic_cases.precondition: scope floor is e2ee_required but the client has no scope encryption key

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_routing_metadata_is_disclosed
semantic_cases.precondition: encrypted response branch
semantic_cases.expected_projection: event_ref, occurrence, schedule_basis_refs, responder actor and ciphertext size are routing-visible and MUST appear in the privacy disclosure; status and comment are not readable

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_validity_is_projection_only
semantic_cases.precondition: basis passes shape and target admission, but decryption later shows the referenced update did not touch the calendar subtree, or the set is not the checkpoint the responder observed
semantic_cases.action: compare the accepted set of an e2ee Realm against a plaintext Realm fed the same events
semantic_cases.expected_projection: both Realms accept the identical canonical set; the discrepancy surfaces only in the authorized projection as unresolved_basis or stale, so a server that happens to read plaintext MUST NOT reject what an e2ee server accepts

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_multiple_refs_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: entry.schedule_basis_refs holds two distinct well-formed ak:event: typed ids where the contract fixes exactly one
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying two schedule_basis_refs items
semantic_cases.expected_projection: Exactly one observed schedule revision is the whole contract, so a second item is rejected at shape admission rather than silently truncated; accepting it would fork both the accepted set and the signed canonical bytes across implementations

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_basis_sorted_ascending_accepted
semantic_cases.precondition: the same two digests as the previous case
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the ascending ordering is the only accepted permutation, so the pair forms an executable positive/negative couple rather than an unenforced prose rule

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_admission_invalid_timed_gregorian_date_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: payload.occurrence is 2026-02-30T09:00:00[America/Los_Angeles], which matches the timed digit pattern but contains a nonexistent Gregorian date
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the receiver parses and validates the signed date component during shape admission; it MUST NOT create a typed current result address for a nonexistent date or defer the check until schedule decryption

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_plaintext_branch_requires_dual_authorization
semantic_cases.precondition: scope floor permits plaintext and both the Realm policy plaintext_data_class enum and the service plaintext_visibility.data_classes declare rsvp_response
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying entry.response in plaintext
semantic_cases.expected_projection: plaintext RSVP is legal only under this combination; the Realm grant and the service declaration are two independent gates and neither alone authorizes it

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_plaintext_branch_realm_only_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: Realm policy declares rsvp_response but the receiving service does not
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying entry.response in plaintext
semantic_cases.expected_projection: the service has no declared plaintext data class for this payload path and MUST NOT read it

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_plaintext_branch_service_only_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: the service declares rsvp_response but the Realm policy enum does not grant it
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying entry.response in plaintext
semantic_cases.expected_projection: a service declaration cannot manufacture Realm authorization; this is the combination the closure review flagged as previously unreachable

semantic_cases.name: rsvp_privacy_plaintext_branch_undeclared_rejected
semantic_cases.precondition: neither side declares rsvp_response
semantic_cases.action: submit ak.rsvp.set carrying entry.response in plaintext
semantic_cases.expected_projection: default posture: plaintext RSVP is refused unless explicitly authorized on both axes
